records.title: Canonical semantics beyond four independent resolved channels
records.statement: Choose and formalize one conservative successor contract: either the structured ambient modal package is the principal Noetic Topos 2.0 semantics, or the resolved semantics gains typed overlap or transition data with proved coherence. The finite discrete product E_legacy^4 alone supplies separation and provenance channels but no cross-atom coupling.
assumptions: The joined context coverage resolves the four singleton atoms
The proposed product-site comparison is E_res equivalent to E_legacy^4
acceptance_criteria: A single conservative successor contract is selected without asserting unproved equivalences
The selected contract has typed definitions and explicit coherence obligations
Any claimed coherence theorem has a schema-valid theorem record and reviewable proof artifact
The four-independent-channel limitation remains explicit unless cross-context coupling is proved
records.claim_boundary: The current finite model is a reference construction. It is not licensed as the final substantive Noetic Topos 2.0 semantics.
